text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Oka Sho. Hishi Amazon drew 
attention as a prime contender for the 
Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon felt a strange sense of deep 
emotion. She felt that following this path 
would allow her to prove her new, stronger 
self—
